---
name: Request a missing game or DLC
about: A game, DLC pack or title update the Store doesn't list
title: 'Missing: '
labels: 'game request'
assignees: ''

---

**What's missing**
The game's full name, and the DLC pack or title update if it's one of those rather than the game itself.

**What kind of title is it**
Xbox 360 disc game / Xbox Live Arcade / indie (XBLIG) / Original Xbox / DLC / title update

**Region and language**
USA, Europe, Japan, etc., and the language if the game has region or language variants.

**Where did you look**
Which Store page or search you tried, and what it showed - nothing at all, or the wrong game.

**Is it on archive.org?**
If you've found it there, paste the link to the item. If you haven't looked, that's fine - say so and I'll check. A few dozen games simply aren't on archive.org, and those I can't add.

**Title ID**
If you know it (eight hex digits, like `4D5307D5`). Optional.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing.
